final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT archstat, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM status_counts) SELECT archstat, record_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > average_share
